thought.text: The within query returned real polygon data from the database. Let me capture clean verification evidence:

reasoning_content: The query is working — it returned actual geospatial data (a polygon of a municipality near the queried point). Let's get a cleaner confirmation: check the status code and the number of returned features/properties.

action.command:
curl -s -o /tmp/within-result.json -w "HTTP_CODE: %{http_code}, SIZE: %{size_download}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/v2/within -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"topics":["gemeinde_f"],"inputGeometries":{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","properties":{},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[13.74,51.04]}}]},"outputFormat":"geojson","returnGeometry":true,"outSRS":4326}'
node -e "const r=require('/tmp/within-result.json'); console.log('features:', r.length, '| type:', r[0].type, '| name:', r[0].properties && Object.keys(r[0].properties).slice(0,8).join(','))"
